modelOverview: The Santos-Dumont is Cartier's original pilot's watch, created in 1904 by Louis Cartier for aviator Alberto Santos-Dumont and widely credited as the first purpose-built wristwatch. Modern large-model pieces preserve the tonneau-shaped case, exposed screws and Roman numeral dial of the historic design, paired with slim, high-autonomy quartz movements. It remains one of Cartier's most recognisable dress watches, prized for its flat, elegant profile rather than sports-watch bulk.

WGSA0021.description: Part of the 2019 relaunch of Cartier's historic pilot's watch, this large-model Santos-Dumont is cased in 18k rose gold with a satin-brushed silver sunray dial and the line's signature exposed screws and beaded, sapphire-set crown. Every piece is sourced and authenticated prior to sale. Confirmed against Cartier's official reference specification: WGSA0021 is catalogued exclusively in 18k rose gold with a silver sunray dial; no yellow gold/ivory variant exists under this reference number.
